verdicts.title: A matroid polytope approach to sharp affine isoperimetric inequalities for volume decomposition functionals
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: New sharp affine isoperimetric inequalities for volume decomposition functionals $X_{2}$ and $X_{3}$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ are established. To fulfil this task, we prove the recursion formulas for volume decomposition functionals and find out the connection between the domains of these functionals and matroid polytopes. Applications of matroid theory to convex geometry are presented.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'sharp affine isoperimetric inequalities for volume decomposition functionals' connecting matroid polytopes to convex geometry, with no mention of polytope integrality, circuit complexity, or MCSP.

verdicts.title: Quasi-matroidal classes of ordered simplicial complexes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce the notion of a quasi-matroidal class of ordered simplicial complexes: an approximation to the idea of a matroid cryptomorphism in the landscape of ordered simplicial complexes. A quasi-matroidal class contains pure shifted simplicial complexes and ordered matroid independence complexes.
